newsitem.title: UK: BP appoints Sutherland non-executive chairman.
newsitem.headline: BP appoints Sutherland non-executive chairman.

text.p: British Petroleum Co Plc said on Wednesday it had appointed Peter Sutherland as non-executive chairman following the resignation of Sir David Simon to take up a UK government ministerial post.
Sutherland takes up his post with immediate effect, BP said in a statement.
The appointment of Sutherland, who is Chairman of Goldman Sachs International and who has been Deputy Chairman of BP since July, 1995, is made on an interim basis.
"The Board will consider the appointment of a long-term successor to Sir David in due course," BP said.
The UK's new Labour Government earlier confirmed that Simon had been appointed minister for trade and competitiveness in Europe.
